reviewer: Kimi actually viewed the exact 65x67 original, the independently enlarged source-note derivative, the complete unchanged 2048x2048 external-07 RGB raw returned by gemini-nano-banana-2.1, the native note crop at x=1050,y=820,width=850,height=680, and the full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-RGB comparison. Checked hair, brows, spectacles, smooth chin, pose, clothing, collar, note groups, right-edge tab and task/prompt/request/result bindings. RGB art is approved before any alpha operation; this is not final production or game approval.

hair_features.reason: Thick swept-back dark hair with a full hairline and short dark sideburns, thick dark eyebrows and round spectacles remain. The chin is smooth with no moustache or beard; no headgear was invented.

collar_fit.reason: The light gray-beige standing collar and dark central closure retain the source's visible structure around a short broad neck transition. No narrow pinched collar, floating cloth, long yellow neck column or cream bib is visible.

entry.positive_observation: The yellow mascot has green-ringed black eyes, one restrained mouth, the source-compatible viewer-left pose, dark swept hair, short sideburns, brows and round spectacles. The light jacket, dark central closure, blue-charcoal photographic backplate and cream note remain. The note has two separated irregular gray-mark groups in each row, with no generic ovals, wedge or uniform bars, and the small dark right-edge tab and blank lower paper are retained.
entry.alpha_decision: The source has alpha extrema 0..255 with a genuine transparent exterior. The returned external-07 image is RGB with returned_alpha_extrema null and a white exterior matte, so it is not final production art. RGB art is approved for the separate source-alpha BILINEAR restoration only; RGB must remain byte-identical in RGB channels, and the final RGBA must be reviewed on white/cyan and alpha before any approval count increases.
entry.visible_limitations: Fine spectacles-rim detail, the exact central closure, small gray-mark stroke shapes and note glyphs cannot be fully resolved at 65x67. Approval covers the visible hair, glasses, clothing, collar, note grouping, composition and backing, not invented readable writing or microscopic identity claims.
